purpose: Small, auditable taxonomy used by the Academic Career normalizer.

evidence_policy.official_url: Captured from source detail/listing or remains unknown.
evidence_policy.visa: Positive values require explicit source language; institution-level inference is not used.
evidence_policy.salary: Only amounts parsed from captured source text are retained.
evidence_policy.deadline: Fixed dates and explicit rolling/open-until-filled language are stored separately.
evidence_policy.business_scope: Explicit business-school evidence outranks business-discipline evidence. Non-business and non-academic records remain in the raw catalogue but are excluded from the default business view.
